description: SuiteSpec: the cells of a matrix run and how many of them run in parallel.

fields.name: suite_run_id
fields.description: Suite run id minted by the server; the parent Graphene run id.
fields.title: Suite run id

fields.name: tenant
fields.description: Tenant slug; every child run lives in the same namespace.
fields.title: Tenant

fields.name: cells
fields.description: The resolved matrix: one child run per cell.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable cell id; the child run id is derived from parent + cell id.
fields.title: Cell id

fields.name: run_spec
fields.description: A complete spec.run@1 value; the suite hands it to a child run unread.
fields.title: RunSpec
Cells

fields.name: concurrency
fields.description: How many cells run at the same time.
fields.title: Concurrency

fields.name: continue_on_failure
fields.description: Keep running the remaining cells after one fails.
fields.title: Continue on failure

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Labels stamped on every child run.
fields.title: Labels

rules.expr: !("cells" in root) || root.cells.all(c, root.cells.filter(x, x.id == c.id).size() == 1)
